body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Planon presented its pen-shape portable color scanner ''DocuPen RC800'' during CES 2007. It takes 4~5 seconds to scan and it can scan store 100’s pages into memory. It can be charged via USB port and you can add memory capacity with a microSD card.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
